findings: subtract() in target/src/calc/__init__.py returns a * b instead of a - b, so the implementation is wrong. For example, subtract(3, 1) returns 3, not 2.

target/tests/test_subtract.py wraps the assertion in try/except Exception: pass. This makes the test close to useless as a check. Note that an AssertionError is an Exception subclass, so the failing assertion is swallowed and the test passes even with the broken a * b implementation. That is the very bug in this diff, and the test hides it.
The test covers only one case, subtract(3, 1). It has no negative-result, zero or negative-operand cases, so coverage is thin even without the try/except.
